sentences.text: Sir Ben Kingsley -LRB- born Krishna Pandit Bhanji ; 31 December 1943 -RRB- is an English actor with a career spanning over 40 years .

He has won an Oscar , Grammy , BAFTA , two Golden Globes , and a Screen Actors Guild Award .	Oscar	Academy Award	Grammy	Grammy Award	BAFTA	British Academy of Film and Television Arts	Golden Globes	Golden Globe Award	Screen Actors Guild Award	Screen Actors Guild Award
